agent.name: agent
agent.summary: Status, model and mode flags of a subscribed agent; sent when a connection starts receiving it and on every change.
agent.title: Agent

goal.name: goal
goal.summary: The main agent's goal state, or a frame without a goal when none is active; sent on every change.
goal.title: Goal

interaction.name: interaction
interaction.summary: Flat, unsequenced approval or question state for a subscribed session; pending interactions are re-sent after every accepted subscription.
interaction.title: Interaction

ping.name: ping
ping.summary: Heartbeat sent by the server every 10 seconds; clients answer with pong. The server closes a connection that sends nothing for 20 seconds, and a client that receives nothing for 25 seconds should reconnect.
ping.title: Ping

response.name: response
response.summary: Reply to one client command, matched by request_id; code 0 means success. Replies to task.watch, task.stop and task.background carry the task state. A command without a request_id closes the connection with code 1008.
response.title: Response

session_event.name: session_event
session_event.summary: Session-scoped agent event envelope; frame type is the payload event type.
session_event.title: Session Event

subscribe.name: subscribe
subscribe.summary: Start receiving agents of one session (agent_ids defaults to the main agent). The response comes first; then every newly added agent gets a turns frame with its latest page, or turns.failed when its conversation cannot be loaded, then turn, item and notice frames. The optional transcript and transcript_since fields attach the per-agent transcript operation stream. When the session cannot be opened, the response carries the error code and nothing is subscribed.
subscribe.title: Subscribe

task.name: task
task.summary: Full state of one task of a subscribed agent, sent on every change; the frame for an ended task is its last one.
task.title: Task

task_background.name: task.background
task_background.summary: Stop the tool call that started a task from waiting for it, so the task keeps running in the background; the response carries its state.
task_background.title: Task Background

task_list.name: task.list
task_list.summary: Every task an agent is running right now, sent when a connection starts receiving that agent; it replaces the client list.
task_list.title: Task List

task_output.name: task.output
task_output.summary: Task output starting at a UTF-8 byte offset, sent only to connections watching the task.
task_output.title: Task Output

task_stop.name: task.stop
task_stop.summary: Stop one task; the response carries its state, and an ended task just replies with it.
task_stop.title: Task Stop

task_unwatch.name: task.unwatch
task_unwatch.summary: Stop streaming one task's output to this connection.
task_unwatch.title: Task Unwatch

task_watch.name: task.watch
task_watch.summary: Stream the output of one task owned by agent_id to this connection without a session subscription. The first chunk covers at most tail_bytes; since_offset resumes after output the client already has.
task_watch.title: Task Watch

todo.name: todo
todo.summary: The agent todo list as items, sent on every change.
todo.title: Todo

unsubscribe.name: unsubscribe
unsubscribe.summary: Stop receiving agents or transcript operations of one session; without agent_ids the whole session is dropped.
unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe

usage.name: usage
usage.summary: Context-window usage of a subscribed agent, throttled to one frame per interval.
usage.title: Usage

info.description: WebSocket protocol for Kimi Code daemon commands, their responses, heartbeat frames, and session event streaming.
info.title: Kimi Code WebSocket API
